categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies the internal HTTP server in src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h.
categories.rationale: Fixes a race condition in the HTTP server where a pipelined request with 'Connection: close' could prematurely terminate the connection and drop queued responses. The issue is real and reproducible with a new unit test, but impacts a narrow edge case since 'bitcoin-cli does not pipeline requests'.
